import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from phase3_generative_loop import build_feature_vector_from_formula, predict_from_formula, load_model, load_features_reference
print('Imports OK')
feature_cols, _ = load_features_reference()
print('Feature cols:', len(feature_cols))
# Test with a simple formula
vec = build_feature_vector_from_formula('SiC', feature_cols)
print('Vector shape:', vec.shape)
print('Non-zero count:', (vec > 0).sum())
print('First 5 values:', vec[:5])
# Test prediction via loaded model
m = load_model()
res = predict_from_formula(m, 'SiC', feature_cols)
print('Prediction result:', res)
